style: Same dark-gold editorial system as pricing-tiers-reveal / revenue-math-reveal: near-black radial bg, League Gothic display caps, Montserrat labels, gold accent. Continuous single-scene build (no hard cuts) so a circular flywheel diagram accumulates state instead of cutting between scenes — this sidesteps the blank-frame transition defect entirely.
font: League Gothic + Montserrat (Google Fonts, same as sibling projects)

customize.note: Catalog searched via `npx hyperframes catalog --query` for orbit/loop/flywheel/cycle/SVG-draw blocks (see catalog-map notes below) — no exact flywheel/cycle-with-traveling-marker block exists in the registry. Closest matches (mk-usage-arc / Hairline Arc Gauge, locked-nucleus-orbit) informed the technique (SVG stroke-dasharray/dashoffset progress ring + a rotated pivot for the traveling marker dot) but are hand-adapted here per builder-contract's 'gap no block covers' clause. Reused verbatim from siblings: :root palette tokens, #bg-fill radial reveal, .scene/.clip padding contract, eyebrow typography, check-mark badge pattern, freeze-hold-to-end ending.

scenes.motion: slide_top + fade_in (eyebrow), ring track fades in underneath as the diagram's static stage so nothing is ever blank

left node column: icon badge scale_punch, label slide_left fade_in, arrow fade_in, emphasis line slide_left + glow pulse; ring progress arc + traveling marker dot continue their single continuous sweep (started at 1.6s) through this beat
right node column: icon badge scale_punch (mirrored), label slide_right fade_in, arrow fade_in, emphasis line slide_right + glow pulse; ring sweep keeps traveling toward full closure

ring sweep lands at full closure ~8.7s with a glow pulse on the whole ring (loop-complete beat), caption fade_in + slide_bottom beneath the ring at ~9.0s, freeze-hold to 11.5s for clean cut back to host footage

diagram.type: hand-authored circular flywheel (SVG progress-ring + CSS pivot-rotated marker)

ring.track: dim static full circle, rgba(245,241,230,0.12) stroke, fades in with the eyebrow (~0.3-0.9s) so the diagram's stage is visible from the start
ring.progress: bright gold (var(--accent)/var(--accent-bright) gradient) stroke-dashoffset sweep driven by one proxy value v:0->1 tweened 1.6s->8.7s, standard -90deg-rotated top-start clockwise technique
ring.marker: small bright dot on a CSS-rotated pivot (transform-origin: center) driven by the SAME proxy v (rotation = v*360), so it is always exactly at the arc's leading tip — guarantees sync without hand-tuned angles
ring.completion_pulse: at v=1 (~8.7s) a box-shadow/glow pulse (yoyo, repeat 1) marks the loop closing

node1.position: left column, vertically centered with the ring (~x=380, y=560), clear of the ring's bounding box
node1.icon: 84px accent-bg circle badge, dark glyph ↑↗ (growth arrow) — same chassis as sibling check-mark badges
node1.label: NEED OPPORTUNITIES (muted eyebrow-style caps)
node1.emphasis: SYSTEM CREATES DEMAND (accent-bright, bold, glow pulse on beat)

node2.icon: 84px accent-bg circle badge, dark glyph ✓ (checkmark) — reuses the pricing-tiers-reveal check-mark pattern
node2.label: FULLY BOOKED (muted eyebrow-style caps)
node2.emphasis: SYSTEM BUILDS REPUTATION (accent-bright, bold, glow pulse on beat)

diagram.collision_check: ring spans x:730-1190 / y:330-790; node1 column ~140-620; node2 column ~1300-1780; eyebrow at y~130 (above ring top 330); closing caption at y~900 (below ring bottom 790) — all clear with >=100px gaps
